newsitem.title: USA: Delta sees Q4 unit revenues growth.
newsitem.headline: Delta sees Q4 unit revenues growth.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc, in a meeting with financial analysts Tuesday, said it expected its fourth quarter unit revenues to rise versus last year and its passenger traffic growth to exceed capacity increases.

Chief Financial Officer Thomas Roeck, speaking to the analysts in New York, said, "We continue to see particularly strong year-over-year increases in leisure demand, and expect to see a corresponding offset to passenger mile yield for the quarter. Overall, we expect to report higher unit revenue in the June 1997 quarter than in the June quarter of 1996."
Delta's fiscal fourth quarter ends in June.
The company said its expectations reflect strong performance in the month of April.

Delta said Monday that system revenue passenger miles increased 10.1 percent in April compared with a year ago. System capacity, the airline added, rose 4.4 percent resulting in a load factor increase of 3.8 points to 72.7 percent.
